notes: No cuts: Hazel's editable scenes are short and every line carries the gift or the dialogue setup; frightened states are handled by variants instead.
Round 3b: branched lines (heart10.outro, birthday.after, courtship.after, courtship2.after, partners.after) now have variants that keep every {if} branch.
'The fourth' (day 4 of each season) recurs as Hazel's hint motif; it never names the ritual and is mild-safe.
dlg.hazel.courtship.r0/r2 are shared by hazel_courtship and hazel_courtship2; their variants apply in both scenes.
dlg.hazel.hiding.0 (clue) has Dr. Penn also suggesting Hazel as reader: a new small fact, no flag; drop it if Penn's lines elsewhere contradict.
Revelation-tier lines (heart10.intro, courtship.r0, dorian_3.l2, wren_3.l3) are hooks, not explanations, and are full-only.
